1	class_name Archer
2	extends Node2D
3	## The hero on the wall walk: slides along X only and fires on its own (GDD 5.1, 6.2).
4	## Aims at the nearest scarecrow inside the upward cone; holds fire when there is none.
5	
6	signal fired(arrow: Arrow)
7	
8	const ARROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/arrow.tscn")
9	
10	var arrows_parent: Node
11	var fire_cooldown := 0.0
12	
13	
14	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
15		var axis := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
16		position.x = clampf(position.x + axis * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * delta,
17				Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN)
18		fire_cooldown = maxf(fire_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
19		if fire_cooldown > 0.0:
20			return
21		var target := nearest_target()
22		if target:
23			_fire_at(target)
24			fire_cooldown = Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL
25	
26	
27	func nearest_target() -> Scarecrow:
28		var best: Scarecrow = null
29		var best_dist := INF
30		var half_cone := deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)
31		for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
32			var s := enemy as Scarecrow
33			if s == null or s.is_dead():
34				continue
35			var to := s.global_position - global_position
36			if absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) > half_cone:
37				continue
38			if to.length() < best_dist:
39				best_dist = to.length()
40				best = s
41		return best
42	
43	
44	func _fire_at(target: Scarecrow) -> void:
45		var arrow := ARROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Arrow
46		var from := global_position + Vector2(0, -24)
47		arrow.launch(from, target.global_position - from)
48		(arrows_parent if arrows_parent else get_parent()).add_child(arrow)
49		fired.emit(arrow)
50

1	class_name Game
2	extends Node2D
3	## One prototype run: survive SURVIVE_TIME seconds of scarecrows without losing the gate.
4	## Owns the run state (gate HP, elapsed time, kills, win/lose). Restart with R/Enter at the end.
5	
6	signal state_changed(new_state: State)
7	
8	enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }
9	
10	const SCARECROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/scarecrow.tscn")
11	const ARCHER_START := Vector2(640, 572)
12	
13	@export var spawning_enabled := true
14	## (start, end) spawn interval used instead of Tuning's when non-zero; only tools/balance_sim.gd sets it.
15	var spawn_interval_override := Vector2.ZERO
16	
17	var state: State = State.PLAYING
18	var gate_hp: float = Tuning.GATE_HP
19	var elapsed := 0.0
20	var kills := 0
21	var spawn_timer := 0.0
22	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
23	
24	@onready var world: Node2D = $World
25	@onready var enemies: Node2D = $World/Enemies
26	@onready var arrows: Node2D = $World/Arrows
27	@onready var archer: Archer = $World/Archer
28	
29	
30	func _ready() -> void:
31		rng.randomize()
32		archer.arrows_parent = arrows
33		reset()
34	
35	
36	func reset() -> void:
37		for child in enemies.get_children() + arrows.get_children():
38			if child.is_in_group("enemies"):
39				child.remove_from_group("enemies")
40			child.queue_free()
41		gate_hp = Tuning.GATE_HP
42		elapsed = 0.0
43		kills = 0
44		spawn_timer = 1.0
45		archer.position = ARCHER_START
46		archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
47		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
48		_set_state(State.PLAYING)
49	
50	
51	func spawn_scarecrow(at: Vector2) -> Scarecrow:
52		var s := SCARECROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Scarecrow
53		s.position = at
54		s.died.connect(func() -> void: kills += 1)
55		s.attacking_gate.connect(_on_attacking_gate)
56		enemies.add_child(s)
57		return s
58	
59	
60	func spawn_interval() -> float:
61		var t := clampf(elapsed / Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
62		if spawn_interval_override != Vector2.ZERO:
63			return lerpf(spawn_interval_override.x, spawn_interval_override.y, t)
64		return lerpf(Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START, Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END, t)
65	
66	
67	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
68		if state != State.PLAYING:
69			return
70		elapsed += delta
71		if elapsed >= Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME:
72			_end(State.WON)
73			return
74		if spawning_enabled:
75			spawn_timer -= delta
76			if spawn_timer <= 0.0:
77				spawn_timer += spawn_interval()
78				spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(rng.randf_range(60.0, Tuning.VIEW.x - 60.0), -40.0))
79	
80	
81	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
82		if state != State.PLAYING and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
83			reset()
84	
85	
86	func _on_attacking_gate(amount: float) -> void:
87		if state != State.PLAYING:
88			return
89		gate_hp = maxf(gate_hp - amount, 0.0)
90		if gate_hp <= 0.0:
91			_end(State.LOST)
92	
93	
94	func _end(result: State) -> void:
95		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED   # freeze the field; HUD shows the result
96		_set_state(result)
97	
98	
99	func _set_state(s: State) -> void:
100		state = s
101		state_changed.emit(s)
102

1	class_name Scarecrow
2	extends Node2D
3	## Straw Scarecrow: walks down to the wall and hits the gate. Straw burns.
4	## Owns the Burning state: burn_time_left > 0 means burning. Fire refreshes it to the full
5	## BURN_DURATION (a second hit does not stack damage). Timed in physics time, so it follows
6	## Engine.time_scale and stops while the tree is paused.
7	
8	signal burning_started
9	signal burning_ended
10	signal died
11	signal attacking_gate(amount: float)
12	signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)
13	
14	const BURN_END_EPSILON := 1e-9      # s; float residue below this counts as burnt out
15	
16	var hp: float = Tuning.SCARECROW_HP
17	var burn_time_left: float = 0.0
18	var at_wall := false
19	
20	
21	func _ready() -> void:
22		add_to_group("enemies")
23		at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
24	
25	
26	func is_burning() -> bool:
27		return burn_time_left > 0.0
28	
29	
30	func is_dead() -> bool:
31		return hp <= 0.0
32	
33	
34	func hit(damage: float, element: StringName) -> void:
35		if is_dead():
36			return
37		hp -= damage
38		if element == &"fire":
39			ignite()
40		hit_taken.emit(global_position)
41		_check_death()
42	
43	
44	func ignite() -> void:
45		var was_burning := is_burning()
46		burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION
47		if not was_burning:
48			burning_started.emit()
49	
50	
51	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
52		if is_dead() or is_queued_for_deletion():   # a reset in the same tick must not hit the gate
53			return
54		if is_burning():
55			var burned := minf(delta, burn_time_left)
56			hp -= Tuning.BURN_DPS * burned
57			burn_time_left -= delta
58			# Summing 240 deltas of 1/60 leaves ~1e-14 instead of 0, which used to add a 241st tick.
59			if burn_time_left <= BURN_END_EPSILON:
60				burn_time_left = 0.0
61				burning_ended.emit()
62			_check_death()
63			if is_dead():
64				return
65		if at_wall:
66			attacking_gate.emit(Tuning.SCARECROW_GATE_DPS * delta)
67		else:
68			position.y = minf(position.y + Tuning.SCARECROW_SPEED * delta, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
69			at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
70	
71	
72	func _check_death() -> void:
73		if is_dead():
74			remove_from_group("enemies")
75			died.emit()
76			queue_free()
77

class_name Arrow
extends Node2D
## A fire arrow: flies straight, hits the first scarecrow within ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, sets it burning.

var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
var element: StringName = &"fire"


func launch(from: Vector2, direction: Vector2) -> void:
	position = from
	velocity = direction.normalized() * Tuning.ARROW_SPEED
	rotation = velocity.angle() + PI / 2.0     # the sprite points up


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	position += velocity * delta
	for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := enemy as Scarecrow
		if s and s.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= Tuning.ARROW_HIT_RADIUS:
			s.hit(Tuning.ARROW_DAMAGE, element)
			queue_free()
			return
	if position.y < -60.0 or position.x < -60.0 or position.x > Tuning.VIEW.x + 60.0:
		queue_free()

3	
4	@export var game_path: NodePath = ^".."
5	
6	@onready var game: Game = get_node(game_path)
7	@onready var status: Label = $Status
8	@onready var banner: Label = $Banner
9	
10	
11	func _ready() -> void:
12		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
13		game.state_changed.connect(func(_s: Game.State) -> void: _refresh_banner())
14		_refresh_banner()
15	
16	
17	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
18		if event.is_action_pressed("pause") and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING:
19			get_tree().paused = not get_tree().paused
20			_refresh_banner()
21			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
22	
23	
24	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
25		status.text = "Gate %d / %d     Time %s / %s     Burned down %d" % [
26			ceili(game.gate_hp), int(Tuning.GATE_HP), _clock(game.elapsed), _clock(Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME), game.kills]
27	
28	
29	func _refresh_banner() -> void:
30		match game.state:
31			Game.State.WON:
32				banner.text = "Mimi is safe!\nR / Enter to play again"
33			Game.State.LOST:
34				banner.text = "The gate fell...\nR / Enter to try again"
35			_:
36				banner.text = "Paused\nEsc / P to resume" if get_tree().paused else ""
37	
38	
39	static func _clock(seconds: float) -> String:
40		var s := int(seconds)
41		return "%d:%02d" % [s / 60, s % 60]

class_name Tuning
## Every gameplay number in one place.
## "GDD" = Mimic Keep GDD v0.1 (Assignment 4); "proto" = chosen for this prototype, to be playtested.

const VIEW := Vector2(1280, 720)
const WALL_TOP := 600.0                # y of the wall walk the archer stands on

const ARCHER_SPEED := 420.0            # px/s, GDD 5.1
const ARCHER_MARGIN := 40.0            # px kept between the archer and the screen edge
const FIRE_INTERVAL := 0.6             # s between auto-fired arrows, proto
const FIRE_CONE_DEG := 120.0           # main weapon targets inside this upward cone, GDD 6.2

const ARROW_SPEED := 900.0             # px/s, proto
const ARROW_DAMAGE := 10.0             # proto
const ARROW_HIT_RADIUS := 26.0         # px from the scarecrow's centre, proto

const SCARECROW_HP := 40.0             # proto
const SCARECROW_SPEED := 45.0          # px/s down the screen, proto
const SCARECROW_GATE_DPS := 5.0        # gate damage per scarecrow at the wall, proto
# Was WALL_TOP - 30 (570): level with the archer (y 572), so a scarecrow at the wall sat ~90 deg off
# the fire cone and was only targeted within 3 px (Rui's playtest 2026-10-29). 500 fixed the aim but
# looked too far from the wall; Rui chose 530 from 500/520/530/540: feet 30 px above the walkway, in
# the cone within +-73 px of the archer.
const SCARECROW_STOP_Y := WALL_TOP - 70.0

const BURN_DURATION := 4.0             # s, GDD 6.3 "Burning: 4 dmg/s for 4 s"
const BURN_DPS := 4.0                  # GDD 6.3

const GATE_HP := 100.0                 # GDD 6.2
const SURVIVE_TIME := 90.0             # s to win the prototype's single wave, proto
# Rui's playtest 2026-10-25 at 2.4 -> 0.9: "目前的怪物数量太多了，很难通关". tools/balance_sim.gd agreed
# (the chasing bot lost 8/8 seeds at ~75 s); at 3.0 -> 1.5 it won 8/8 and standing still lost 7/8.
const SPAWN_INTERVAL_START := 3.0      # s between scarecrows at the start, proto
const SPAWN_INTERVAL_END := 1.5        # s between scarecrows at SURVIVE_TIME, proto

1	extends SceneTree
2	## Keyboard checks: real InputEventKey events through Input.parse_input_event, into the main scene.
3	##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_input.gd --fixed-fps 60
4	## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.
5	
6	const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
7	const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
8	
9	var passed := 0
10	var failed := 0
11	var game: Game
12	
13	
14	func _initialize() -> void:
15		_run.call_deferred()
16	
17	
18	func _run() -> void:
19		game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
20		game.spawning_enabled = false
21		root.add_child(game)
22		await process_frame
23	
24		await _test_move(KEY_D, 1.0, "D")
25		await _test_move(KEY_RIGHT, 1.0, "Right arrow")
26		await _test_move(KEY_A, -1.0, "A")
27		await _test_move(KEY_LEFT, -1.0, "Left arrow")
28		await _test_clamp()
29		await _test_pause(KEY_ESCAPE, "Esc")
30		await _test_pause(KEY_P, "P")
31		await _test_restart()
32	
33		print("test_input: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
34		quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)
35	
36	
37	func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
38		if ok:
39			passed += 1
40			print("PASS %s" % name)
41		else:
42			failed += 1
43			print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])
44	
45	
46	func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
47		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
48		ev.keycode = code
49		ev.physical_keycode = code
50		ev.pressed = pressed
51		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
52		Input.flush_buffered_events()
53	
54	
55	func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
56		for i in roundi(s / TICK):
57			await physics_frame
58	
59	
60	func _test_move(code: Key, sign_x: float, label: String) -> void:
61		game.reset()
62		await process_frame
63		var x0 := game.archer.position.x
64		_key(code, true)
65		await _seconds(0.5)
66		_key(code, false)
67		await _seconds(0.1)
68		var moved := game.archer.position.x - x0
69		var expect := sign_x * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * 0.5
70		_check("%s moves the archer %+.0f px in 0.5 s" % [label, expect],
71				absf(moved - expect) <= Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK + 0.01, "moved %.2f" % moved)
72	
73	
74	func _test_clamp() -> void:
75		game.reset()
76		await process_frame
77		_key(KEY_D, true)
78		await _seconds(3.0)
79		_key(KEY_D, false)
80		_check("the archer stops at the right edge",
81				is_equal_approx(game.archer.position.x, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN),
82				"x=%.2f" % game.archer.position.x)
83	
84	
85	func _test_pause(code: Key, label: String) -> void:
86		game.reset()
87		await process_frame
88		_key(code, true)
89		_key(code, false)
90		await process_frame
91		_check("%s pauses" % label, paused)
92		var t := game.elapsed
93		await _seconds(0.5)
94		_check("%s: the run clock stops while paused" % label, game.elapsed == t)
95		_key(code, true)
96		_key(code, false)
97		await process_frame
98		_check("%s resumes" % label, not paused)
99	
100	
101	func _test_restart() -> void:
102		game.reset()
103		await process_frame
104		game.gate_hp = 50.0
105		_key(KEY_R, true)
106		_key(KEY_R, false)
107		await process_frame
108		_check("R does nothing during play", game.gate_hp == 50.0 and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING)
109		for i in 10:
110			game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(100 + i * 100, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
111		game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
112		await _seconds(2.0)
113		_check("the run is lost (setup for restart)", game.state == Game.State.LOST)
114		_key(KEY_ENTER, true)
115		_key(KEY_ENTER, false)
116		await process_frame
117		_check("Enter restarts after a loss", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.gate_hp == Tuning.GATE_HP)
118		game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT

extends SceneTree
## Keyboard checks: real InputEventKey events through Input.parse_input_event, into the main scene.
##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_input.gd --fixed-fps 60
## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0

var passed := 0
var failed := 0
var game: Game


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame

	await _test_move(KEY_D, 1.0, "D")
	await _test_move(KEY_RIGHT, 1.0, "Right arrow")
	await _test_move(KEY_A, -1.0, "A")
	await _test_move(KEY_LEFT, -1.0, "Left arrow")
	await _test_clamp()
	await _test_pause(KEY_ESCAPE, "Esc")
	await _test_pause(KEY_P, "P")
	await _test_restart()

	print("test_input: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
	for i in roundi(s / TICK):
		await physics_frame


func _test_move(code: Key, sign_x: float, label: String) -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	var x0 := game.archer.position.x
	_key(code, true)
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_key(code, false)
	await _seconds(0.1)
	var moved := game.archer.position.x - x0
	var expect := sign_x * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * 0.5
	_check("%s moves the archer %+.0f px in 0.5 s" % [label, expect],
			absf(moved - expect) <= Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK + 0.01, "moved %.2f" % moved)


func _test_clamp() -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	await _seconds(3.0)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_check("the archer stops at the right edge",
			is_equal_approx(game.archer.position.x, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN),
			"x=%.2f" % game.archer.position.x)


func _test_pause(code: Key, label: String) -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s pauses" % label, paused)
	var t := game.elapsed
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_check("%s: the run clock stops while paused" % label, game.elapsed == t)
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s resumes" % label, not paused)


func _test_restart() -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	game.gate_hp = 50.0
	_key(KEY_R, true)
	_key(KEY_R, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("R does nothing during play", game.gate_hp == 50.0 and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING)
	for i in 10:
		game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(100 + i * 100, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
	game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await _seconds(2.0)
	_check("the run is lost (setup for restart)", game.state == Game.State.LOST)
	_key(KEY_ENTER, true)
	_key(KEY_ENTER, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("Enter restarts after a loss", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.gate_hp == Tuning.GATE_HP)
	game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT

247		_check("A3: no hit cleared, freed or stopped an earlier live burst", earlier_ok, earlier_detail)

282	## Rule A1: an arrow that leaves the screen creates nothing.
283	func _phase_miss() -> void:
284		var h0 := hits.size()
285		var b0 := bursts.size()
286		var a0 := arrow_ends.size()
287		var m := _spawn(Vector2(640, 100), "M")
288		var arrow: Arrow = await game.archer.fired
289		m.remove_from_group("enemies")     # target removed in flight, as test_wall_targeting.gd does

291		var cap := 120
292		while cap > 0 and is_instance_valid(arrow):
293			await physics_frame
294			cap -= 1
295		await _ticks(2)
296		var ended_off: bool = arrow_ends.size() - a0 == 1 and not arrow_ends[a0]["on_screen"]
297		_check("A1 setup: the arrow left the screen without hitting", ended_off,
298				"ends=%s" % str(arrow_ends.slice(a0)))
299		_check("A1: an arrow leaving the screen creates no hit_taken and no burst",
300				hits.size() == h0 and bursts.size() == b0, "hits=%d bursts=%d" % [hits.size() - h0, bursts.size() - b0])
301	
302	
303	## Rule A1: Burning ending on its own creates nothing. One fire arrow, then real D key events take the
304	## archer away until the scarecrow is outside the fire cone; wait for its own burning_ended.
305	func _phase_burn_out() -> void:
306		var h0 := hits.size()
307		var f0 := fired_count
308		var b := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "B")
309		b.burning_ended.connect(func() -> void:
310			burn_end_frame = _frame()
311			bursts_at_burn_end = bursts.size())
312		await game.archer.fired
313		await process_frame
314		_key(KEY_D, true)
315		var cap := 120
316		while cap > 0 and _hits_on("B", h0) == 0:
317			await physics_frame
318			cap -= 1
319		var hit_frame := _frame()
320		var bursts_after_hit := bursts.size()
321		cap = 420
322		while cap > 0 and burn_end_frame < 0:
323			await physics_frame
324			cap -= 1
325			if game.archer.position.x >= Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN:
326				_key(KEY_D, false)
327		_key(KEY_D, false)
328		var ended := burn_end_frame >= 0
329		var out_of_cone := ended and is_instance_valid(b) and game.archer.nearest_target() != b
330		var alive := ended and is_instance_valid(b) and not b.is_dead() and not b.is_burning()
331		await _ticks(10)
332		print("INFO burn-out: hit at frame %d, burning_ended at frame %d (%d frames), archer x=%.0f" % [
333			hit_frame, burn_end_frame, burn_end_frame - hit_frame, game.archer.position.x])
334		_check("burn-out setup: exactly one arrow fired and one hit on the scarecrow",
335				fired_count - f0 == 1 and _hits_on("B", h0) == 1,
336				"fired=%d hits=%d" % [fired_count - f0, _hits_on("B", h0)])
337		_check("burn-out setup: burning_ended fired with the scarecrow alive and outside the fire cone",
338				ended and alive and out_of_cone, "ended=%s alive=%s out_of_cone=%s" % [ended, alive, out_of_cone])
339		_check("A1: no burst created in the burning_ended frame", ended and bursts_at_burn_end == bursts_after_hit,
340				"at_end=%d after_hit=%d" % [bursts_at_burn_end, bursts_after_hit])
341		_check("A1: no burst created while it burned on its own (burn ticks, movement) or 10 frames after",
342				bursts.size() == bursts_after_hit and hits.size() - h0 == 1,
343				"new bursts=%d" % (bursts.size() - bursts_after_hit))
344	
345	
346	## Rule A5: a burst alive when the run is lost survives the R restart and frees itself within 1.20 s.
347	func _phase_reset() -> void:
348		var h0 := hits.size()
349		var b0 := bursts.size()
350		var ax := game.archer.position.x
351		for dx in [-40.0, -50.0, -60.0]:
352			_spawn(Vector2(ax + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "R")
353		for x in [100.0, 200.0, 300.0, 400.0, 500.0]:
354			_spawn(Vector2(x, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "W")
355		var cap := 900
356		while cap > 0 and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING:
357			await physics_frame
358			cap -= 1
359		var live_at_loss := _live_bursts()
360		print("INFO reset: run lost at frame %d, %d bursts live" % [_frame(), live_at_loss])
361		_check("A5 setup: the run is lost with a live burst", game.state == Game.State.LOST and live_at_loss > 0,
362				"state=%d live=%d" % [game.state, live_at_loss])
363		await _ticks(30)
364		print("INFO reset: 30 frames after the loss (World disabled), %d bursts still live" % _live_bursts())
365		track_arrows = false
366		var b_before_r := bursts.size()
367		_check("A1: every hit in this phase made exactly one burst", b_before_r - b0 == hits.size() - h0,
368				"bursts=%d hits=%d" % [b_before_r - b0, hits.size() - h0])
369		_key(KEY_R, true)
370		_key(KEY_R, false)
371		var r_frame := _frame()
372		await process_frame
373		_check("A5 setup: R restarts the run", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING)
374		cap = 120
375		while cap > 0 and effects.get_child_count() > 0:
376			await physics_frame
377			cap -= 1
378		var took := _frame() - r_frame
379		print("INFO reset: World/Effects empty %d frames after R" % took)
380		_check("A5: after R with a live burst, World/Effects is empty within %d frames (1.20 s)" % RESET_LIMIT_FRAMES,
381				effects.get_child_count() == 0 and took <= RESET_LIMIT_FRAMES, "took=%d" % took)
382		_check("A1: the reset itself creates no burst", bursts.size() == b_before_r,
383				"new=%d" % (bursts.size() - b_before_r))
384

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _frame() -> int:
	return Engine.get_physics_frames()


func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _ticks(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame


# ---- listeners (read only) -------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_node_added(n: Node) -> void:
	if n.scene_file_path != BURST_PATH:
		return
	var rec := {"node": n, "parent_ok": n.get_parent() == effects, "created": _frame(), "freed": -1}
	bursts.append(rec)
	n.tree_exited.connect(func() -> void: rec["freed"] = _frame())


func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	fired_count += 1
	arrow.tree_exiting.connect(func() -> void:
		if not track_arrows:
			return
		var p := arrow.position
		var off := p.y < -60.0 or p.x < -60.0 or p.x > Tuning.VIEW.x + 60.0
		arrow_ends.append({"on_screen": not off, "pos": p}))


func _on_hit_taken(at: Vector2, s: Scarecrow) -> void:
	# The scarecrow's own ImpactSpawner connected first (in _ready), so its burst already exists.
	var now := _frame()
	var b: Dictionary = bursts.back() if not bursts.is_empty() else {}
	var burst_pos := Vector2.INF
	if not b.is_empty() and b["created"] == now and is_instance_valid(b["node"]):
		burst_pos = (b["node"] as Node2D).global_position
	# Rule A3: every earlier burst still inside its lifetime must be alive, the same instance, emitting.
	var earlier_ok := true
	var earlier_detail := ""
	for e in bursts:
		if e == b or now - int(e["created"]) >= BURST_FRAMES - BURST_FRAMES_TOL:
			continue
		var node: Node = e["node"]
		var alive := is_instance_valid(node) and node.is_inside_tree() and not node.is_queued_for_deletion()
		var emitting := alive and (node.get_node("Straw") as GPUParticles2D).emitting
		if not (alive and emitting):
			earlier_ok = false
			earlier_detail += "[burst from frame %d alive=%s emitting=%s] " % [e["created"], alive, emitting]
	hits.append({"frame": now, "label": labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"), "sid": s.get_instance_id(),
		"at": at, "s_pos": s.global_position, "lethal": s.hp <= 0.0, "burst": b, "burst_pos": burst_pos,
		"bursts_total": bursts.size(), "live": _live_bursts(), "earlier_ok": earlier_ok,
		"earlier_detail": earlier_detail})


func _live_bursts() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in effects.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var sid := s.get_instance_id()
	labels[sid] = label
	s.hit_taken.connect(_on_hit_taken.bind(s))
	s.tree_exited.connect(func() -> void: freed_at[sid] = _frame())
	return s


func _hits_on(label: String, from: int) -> int:
	var n := 0
	for i in range(from, hits.size()):
		if hits[i]["label"] == label:
			n += 1
	return n


# ---- run -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _run() -> void:
	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	effects = game.get_node_or_null("World/Effects") as Node2D
	game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
	await process_frame

	await _phase_load()
	await _phase_overlap_and_lethal()
	await _phase_miss()
	await _phase_burn_out()
	await _phase_reset()

	print("test_impact_burst_state: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


## Rule A1: nothing on scene load.
func _phase_load() -> void:
	_check("World/Effects exists, a Node2D after World/Archer", effects != null
			and effects.get_index() > game.archer.get_index())
	await _ticks(30)
	_check("A1: scene load + 30 frames, no scarecrow: 0 bursts created", bursts.is_empty(),
			"created=%d" % bursts.size())
	_check("A1: scene load: World/Effects is empty", effects.get_child_count() == 0)


## Rules A1-A4 with real arrows at uneven flight times: far F (long flight), then near N at the wall
## (short flight). Runs until every scarecrow, arrow and burst is gone.
func _phase_overlap_and_lethal() -> void:
	var h0 := hits.size()
	var b0 := bursts.size()
	var a0 := arrow_ends.size()
	var f0 := fired_count
	var t0 := _frame()
	_spawn(Vector2(640, 0), "F")
	await game.archer.fired
	_spawn(Vector2(680, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "N")
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0 and (not get_nodes_in_group("enemies").is_empty()
			or game.arrows.get_child_count() > 0 or effects.get_child_count() > 0):
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
	_check("phase 1 finished: all scarecrows, arrows and bursts gone within 15 s", cap > 0)

	for i in range(h0, hits.size()):
		var h := hits[i]
		print("INFO hit %d on %s at frame %d (t=%.3f s) pos=%s lethal=%s live_bursts=%d" % [i - h0 + 1,
			h["label"], h["frame"], (int(h["frame"]) - t0) / 60.0, h["at"], h["lethal"], h["live"]])
	for i in range(b0, bursts.size()):
		var b := bursts[i]
		print("INFO burst %d created frame %d freed frame %d lifetime %d frames" % [i - b0 + 1,
			b["created"], b["freed"], int(b["freed"]) - int(b["created"])])

	var n_hits := hits.size() - h0
	var n_bursts := bursts.size() - b0
	var on_screen := 0
	for i in range(a0, arrow_ends.size()):
		if arrow_ends[i]["on_screen"]:
			on_screen += 1
	_check("A1: bursts created == hit_taken count == arrows ended on a hit", n_hits > 0
			and n_bursts == n_hits and on_screen == n_hits,
			"bursts=%d hits=%d on_screen_arrow_ends=%d" % [n_bursts, n_hits, on_screen])
	_check("A1: every fired arrow is accounted for", arrow_ends.size() - a0 == fired_count - f0,
			"ended=%d fired=%d" % [arrow_ends.size() - a0, fired_count - f0])

	var one_each := true
	var pos_ok := true
	var sig_ok := true
	var pos_detail := ""
	for i in range(h0, hits.size()):
		var h := hits[i]
		var b: Dictionary = h["burst"]
		if b.is_empty() or int(b["created"]) != int(h["frame"]) or int(h["bursts_total"]) - b0 != i - h0 + 1:
			one_each = false
		var d: float = (h["burst_pos"] as Vector2).distance_to(h["at"])
		if not d <= POS_TOL:
			pos_ok = false
			pos_detail += "[hit %d: burst %s signal %s] " % [i - h0 + 1, h["burst_pos"], h["at"]]
		if (h["s_pos"] as Vector2).distance_to(h["at"]) > POS_TOL:
			sig_ok = false
	_check("A1: each hit_taken created exactly one burst, in the same frame", one_each)
	_check("A2: burst global_position == hit_taken position (+-%.0f px)" % POS_TOL, pos_ok, pos_detail)
	_check("A2: hit_taken position == the scarecrow's global_position at the hit", sig_ok)

	var parents_ok := true
	for i in range(b0, bursts.size()):
		parents_ok = parents_ok and bool(bursts[i]["parent_ok"])
	_check("A2/A4: every burst was added under World/Effects, none under a scarecrow", parents_ok)

	# Rule A3: overlap.
	if n_hits >= 3:
		var gap := int(hits[h0 + 1]["frame"]) - int(hits[h0]["frame"])
		_check("A3 setup: hits 1 and 2 land inside one burst lifetime (%d frames apart)" % gap,
				gap < BURST_FRAMES, "gap=%d" % gap)
		_check("A3: three distinct bursts are alive at the third impact", int(hits[h0 + 2]["live"]) == 3,
				"live=%d" % int(hits[h0 + 2]["live"]))
		var ids := {}
		for i in range(h0, h0 + 3):
			ids[(hits[i]["burst"] as Dictionary)["node"]] = true
		_check("A3: the first three hits made three different instances", ids.size() == 3)
	else:
		_check("A3: at least three hits happened", false, "hits=%d" % n_hits)
	var earlier_ok := true
	var earlier_detail := ""
	for i in range(h0, hits.size()):
		if not hits[i]["earlier_ok"]:
			earlier_ok = false
			earlier_detail += hits[i]["earlier_detail"]
	_check("A3: no hit cleared, freed or stopped an earlier live burst", earlier_ok, earlier_detail)
	var life_ok := true
	var life_detail := ""
	for i in range(b0, bursts.size()):
		var life := int(bursts[i]["freed"]) - int(bursts[i]["created"])
		if int(bursts[i]["freed"]) < 0 or absi(life - BURST_FRAMES) > BURST_FRAMES_TOL:
			life_ok = false
			life_detail += "[burst %d: %d frames] " % [i - b0 + 1, life]
	_check("A3/A5: every burst freed itself after %d +-%d frames (no restart, no early clear)" % [
			BURST_FRAMES, BURST_FRAMES_TOL], life_ok, life_detail)

	# Rule A4: lethal hit.
	var lethal := 0
	var lethal_ok := true
	var lethal_detail := ""
	for i in range(h0, hits.size()):
		var h := hits[i]
		if not h["lethal"]:
			continue
		lethal += 1
		var b: Dictionary = h["burst"]
		var s_freed: int = freed_at.get(h["sid"], -1)
		var b_life := int(b["freed"]) - int(b["created"])
		print("INFO lethal hit on %s at frame %d: scarecrow left the tree at frame %d, its burst at frame %d" % [
			h["label"], h["frame"], s_freed, b["freed"]])
		if s_freed != int(h["frame"]) or int(b["freed"]) <= s_freed or absi(b_life - BURST_FRAMES) > BURST_FRAMES_TOL:
			lethal_ok = false
			lethal_detail += "[%s s_freed=%d b_freed=%d life=%d] " % [h["label"], s_freed, b["freed"], b_life]
	_check("A4 setup: at least one real arrow hit was lethal", lethal > 0, "lethal=%d" % lethal)
	_check("A4: lethal hit: scarecrow freed that frame, its burst outlived it and ran its full lifetime",
			lethal > 0 and lethal_ok, lethal_detail)
	_check("A5: World/Effects holds no finished bursts", effects.get_child_count() == 0,
			"children=%d" % effects.get_child_count())


## Rule A1: an arrow that leaves the screen creates nothing.
func _phase_miss() -> void:
	var h0 := hits.size()
	var b0 := bursts.size()
	var a0 := arrow_ends.size()
	var m := _spawn(Vector2(640, 100), "M")
	var arrow: Arrow = await game.archer.fired
	m.remove_from_group("enemies")     # target removed in flight, as test_wall_targeting.gd does
	m.queue_free()
	var cap := 120
	while cap > 0 and is_instance_valid(arrow):
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
	await _ticks(2)
	var ended_off: bool = arrow_ends.size() - a0 == 1 and not arrow_ends[a0]["on_screen"]
	_check("A1 setup: the arrow left the screen without hitting", ended_off,
			"ends=%s" % str(arrow_ends.slice(a0)))
	_check("A1: an arrow leaving the screen creates no hit_taken and no burst",
			hits.size() == h0 and bursts.size() == b0, "hits=%d bursts=%d" % [hits.size() - h0, bursts.size() - b0])


## Rule A1: Burning ending on its own creates nothing. One fire arrow, then real D key events take the
## archer away until the scarecrow is outside the fire cone; wait for its own burning_ended.
func _phase_burn_out() -> void:
	var h0 := hits.size()
	var f0 := fired_count
	var b := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "B")
	b.burning_ended.connect(func() -> void:
		burn_end_frame = _frame()
		bursts_at_burn_end = bursts.size())
	await game.archer.fired
	await process_frame
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	var cap := 120
	while cap > 0 and _hits_on("B", h0) == 0:
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
	var hit_frame := _frame()
	var bursts_after_hit := bursts.size()
	cap = 420
	while cap > 0 and burn_end_frame < 0:
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
		if game.archer.position.x >= Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN:
			_key(KEY_D, false)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	var ended := burn_end_frame >= 0
	var out_of_cone := ended and is_instance_valid(b) and game.archer.nearest_target() != b
	var alive := ended and is_instance_valid(b) and not b.is_dead() and not b.is_burning()
	await _ticks(10)
	print("INFO burn-out: hit at frame %d, burning_ended at frame %d (%d frames), archer x=%.0f" % [
		hit_frame, burn_end_frame, burn_end_frame - hit_frame, game.archer.position.x])
	_check("burn-out setup: exactly one arrow fired and one hit on the scarecrow",
			fired_count - f0 == 1 and _hits_on("B", h0) == 1,
			"fired=%d hits=%d" % [fired_count - f0, _hits_on("B", h0)])
	_check("burn-out setup: burning_ended fired with the scarecrow alive and outside the fire cone",
			ended and alive and out_of_cone, "ended=%s alive=%s out_of_cone=%s" % [ended, alive, out_of_cone])
	_check("A1: no burst created in the burning_ended frame", ended and bursts_at_burn_end == bursts_after_hit,
			"at_end=%d after_hit=%d" % [bursts_at_burn_end, bursts_after_hit])
	_check("A1: no burst created while it burned on its own (burn ticks, movement) or 10 frames after",
			bursts.size() == bursts_after_hit and hits.size() - h0 == 1,
			"new bursts=%d" % (bursts.size() - bursts_after_hit))


## Rule A5: a burst alive when the run is lost survives the R restart and frees itself within 1.20 s.
func _phase_reset() -> void:
	var h0 := hits.size()
	var b0 := bursts.size()
	var ax := game.archer.position.x
	for dx in [-40.0, -50.0, -60.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(ax + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "R")
	for x in [100.0, 200.0, 300.0, 400.0, 500.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(x, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "W")
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0 and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING:
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
	var live_at_loss := _live_bursts()
	print("INFO reset: run lost at frame %d, %d bursts live" % [_frame(), live_at_loss])
	_check("A5 setup: the run is lost with a live burst", game.state == Game.State.LOST and live_at_loss > 0,
			"state=%d live=%d" % [game.state, live_at_loss])
	await _ticks(30)
	print("INFO reset: 30 frames after the loss (World disabled), %d bursts still live" % _live_bursts())
	track_arrows = false
	var b_before_r := bursts.size()
	_check("A1: every hit in this phase made exactly one burst", b_before_r - b0 == hits.size() - h0,
			"bursts=%d hits=%d" % [b_before_r - b0, hits.size() - h0])
	_key(KEY_R, true)
	_key(KEY_R, false)
	var r_frame := _frame()
	await process_frame
	_check("A5 setup: R restarts the run", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING)
	cap = 120
	while cap > 0 and effects.get_child_count() > 0:
		await physics_frame
		cap -= 1
	var took := _frame() - r_frame
	print("INFO reset: World/Effects empty %d frames after R" % took)
	_check("A5: after R with a live burst, World/Effects is empty within %d frames (1.20 s)" % RESET_LIMIT_FRAMES,
			effects.get_child_count() == 0 and took <= RESET_LIMIT_FRAMES, "took=%d" % took)
	_check("A1: the reset itself creates no burst", bursts.size() == b_before_r,
			"new=%d" % (bursts.size() - b_before_r))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p logs
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
    fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
    fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
log="logs/$(basename "$1" .gd)_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" godot --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path godot --script "res://tests/$1" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR|Failed loading resource" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

extends SceneTree
## Step 2 pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §5, §10): what the archer does NOW, before any clip exists.
## Drives the real main scene only through keyboard events (Input.parse_input_event); never calls an
## archer or scarecrow method that changes state, never assigns to their variables. It only spawns
## scarecrows with Game.spawn_scarecrow() and reads state.
##   ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
##
## Frame model. --fixed-fps 60 and 60 physics ticks/s: one main-loop iteration = one physics tick.
## The script resumes on SceneTree.physics_frame, which is emitted BEFORE the nodes' physics step.
## So at each resume the world shows the result of the previous tick, and whatever the script does
## there (keys, spawns) takes effect in the next tick. A scenario's frame f counts game ticks
## completed since the scenario's setup (f = 0 is the setup itself). An event emitted during a
## tick (fired, died) is stamped with that tick's f and shows up in the log line of the same f.
## Every log line begins with Engine.get_process_frames() at the moment it is printed.
##
## TIMING = numbers the brief changes on purpose (§5); re-pinned in Step 6.
## INVARIANT = must survive the change.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
const FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS := 36            # Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL (0.6 s) at 60 ticks/s

# ---- scenario design (chosen, not measured) ----------------------------------------------------
const C_HOLD_D_TICKS := 40                 # (c) D held for ticks 1..40, then A for ticks 41..80
const C_HOLD_A_TICKS := 40
const D_PAUSE_AT_F := 15                   # (d) P pressed after tick 15 ...
const D_PAUSE_TICKS := 30                  # ... and again 30 ticks later
const E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS := 30              # (e) ticks watched after the scarecrow reaches the wall
const F_FROZEN_TICKS := 30                 # (f) ticks watched after the loss before R

# ---- TIMING: measured on baseline 2026-11-21 ----------------------------------------------------
const A_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (a) spawn (in the cone, cooldown 0) at f 0 -> first fired
const A_SHOT_GAPS := [-999]                # (a) ticks between consecutive shots
const A_DEATH_F := -999                    # (a) tick the scarecrow dies
const B_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (b) spawn at f 0 -> first fired
const B_SHOT_GAPS := [-999]
const C_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (c) spawn at f 0 -> first fired
const C_EXIT_F := -999                     # (c) first frame the target is outside the cone
const C_CD_ZERO_F := -999                  # (c) first frame the cooldown is 0 while it is outside
const C_REENTRY_F := -999                  # (c) first frame it is back inside the cone
const C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY := -999         # (c) fired frame - re-entry frame
const D_SHOT1_F := -999                    # (d) first fired
const D_SHOT2_F := -999                    # (d) second fired, after the pause
const D_PAUSE_SHIFT := -999                # (d) (shot2 - shot1) - unpaused cadence
const E_WALL_F := -999                     # (e) spawn at y 400 at f 0 -> first frame at_wall
const F_LOSS_F := -999                     # (f) frame the run is LOST
const F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY := -999         # (f) new run: spawn at f_s -> fired frame - f_s

var game: Game
var timing: Array[String] = []
var invariant: Array[String] = []
var passed := 0
var failed := 0

var scen := ""
var f := 0                 # ticks completed since the scenario's setup
var gt := 0                # ticks completed since the test started
var run_id := 0            # incremented by each restart
var act := 0               # ticks the archer processed (not paused, World enabled) in this run
var next_active := true    # will the archer process the coming tick?
var prev_cd := 0.0
var pending: Array[Dictionary] = []   # fired events since the last log line
var shots: Array[Dictionary] = []     # every fired event
var arrows_added := 0                 # arrows that entered World/Arrows since the last log line
var tracked: Array[int] = []          # scarecrow instance ids
var labels := {}                      # id -> label
var deaths := {}                      # label -> {scen, f}
var wall_prev := {}                   # id -> [at_wall, y] at the previous log line
var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
var last_key := -1
var last_key_gt := -1

# invariant counters, whole run
var inv_inactive_shots := 0
var inv_inactive_cd_changes := 0
var inv_inactive_detail := ""
var inv_arrow_mismatch := 0
var inv_arrow_detail := ""
var inv_wall_moves := 0
var inv_wall_detail := ""


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
	game.arrows.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: arrows_added += 1)
	game.state_changed.connect(_on_state_changed)
	await process_frame
	scen = "boot"
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

	await _scen_a()
	await _scen_b()
	await _scen_c()
	await _scen_d()
	await _scen_e()
	await _scen_f()
	_global_invariants()

	print("== TIMING (changed on purpose by brief §5; re-pinned in Step 6) ==")
	for line in timing:
		print(line)
	print("== INVARIANT (must survive the change) ==")
	for line in invariant:
		print(line)
	print("RESULT test_pins_a7: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# ---- checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _record(group: Array[String], name: String, ok: bool, detail: String) -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		group.append("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		group.append("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _timing(name: String, measured: Variant, pinned: Variant) -> void:
	_record(timing, "%s = %s" % [name, str(pinned)], measured == pinned, "measured %s" % str(measured))


func _inv(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	_record(invariant, name, ok, detail)


# ---- input --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	if pressed:
		last_key = code
		last_key_gt = gt
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _tap(code: Key) -> void:
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)


# ---- reading the world --------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _in_cone(s: Scarecrow) -> bool:
	var to := s.global_position - game.archer.global_position
	return absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) <= deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)


func _live(id: int) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
	if s == null or not s.is_inside_tree() or s.is_queued_for_deletion() or s.is_dead():
		return null
	return s


func _nearest_in_cone() -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_d := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead() or not _in_cone(s):
			continue
		var d := (s.global_position - game.archer.global_position).length()
		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = s
	return best


func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_a := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
		if a < best_a:
			best_a = a
			best = s
	return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null


func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
	return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))


func _live_arrows() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.arrows.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	tracked.append(id)
	labels[id] = label
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
	return s


func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for s in shots:
		if s["scen"] == sc:
			out.append(s)
	return out


func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for i in range(1, list.size()):
		out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))
	return out


# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
	var near := _nearest_in_cone()
	var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
		"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
		"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
		"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
	pending.append(ev)
	shots.append(ev)


func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
	transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f, "gt": gt, "state": s, "key": last_key,
		"key_age": gt - last_key_gt})


# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _step() -> void:
	next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await physics_frame
	f += 1
	gt += 1
	if next_active:
		act += 1
	var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown

	if not next_active:
		if not pending.is_empty():
			inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
		if cd != prev_cd:
			inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
	if arrows_added != pending.size():
		inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
		inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]

	var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for e in pending:
		fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
	var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for id in tracked:
		var s := _live(id)
		if s == null:
			wall_prev.erase(id)
			continue
		sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
			s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
		if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
		if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
		wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]

	print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
		Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
		game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
	pending.clear()
	arrows_added = 0
	prev_cd = cd


func _begin(name: String) -> void:
	scen = name
	f = 0
	print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)


## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0:
		var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
		for id in tracked:
			if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
				busy = true
		if not busy:
			break
		await _step()
		cap -= 1
	for i in 3:
		await _step()


# ---- scenarios ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## (a) One scarecrow in the cone, cooldown 0: the first shots until it dies.
func _scen_a() -> void:
	_begin("a")
	var cd0 := game.archer.fire_cooldown
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "A1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var in_cone0 := _in_cone(s)
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("a")
	var first := int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
	print("MEASURED a: cooldown at spawn %.6f, in cone at spawn %s, shots at f %s, gaps %s, died at f %s" % [
		cd0, in_cone0, str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(a) setup: cooldown 0 and the scarecrow inside the cone at spawn", cd0 == 0.0 and in_cone0)
	_timing("(a) first fired frame after a spawn in the cone (spawn = f 0)", first, A_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(a) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), A_SHOT_GAPS)
	_timing("(a) frame the scarecrow dies", int(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1)), A_DEATH_F)
	await _settle()


## (b) Two scarecrows in the cone: which one is taken, and the cadence.
func _scen_b() -> void:
	_begin("b")
	var near := _spawn(Vector2(600, 350), "B_near")
	var far := _spawn(Vector2(690, 250), "B_far")
	var ids: Array[int] = [near.get_instance_id(), far.get_instance_id()]
	var both_in := _in_cone(near) and _in_cone(far)
	while (_live(ids[0]) != null or _live(ids[1]) != null) and f < 900:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("b")
	var targets := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> String: return e["target"])
	print("MEASURED b: shots at f %s, targets %s, gaps %s, B_near died f %s, B_far died f %s" % [
		str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(targets), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", -1)), str(deaths.get("B_far", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(b) setup: both scarecrows inside the cone at spawn", both_in)
	var near_first := not list.is_empty() and list[0]["target"] == "B_near"
	_inv("(b) the first shot takes the nearer scarecrow (B_near)", near_first, "targets %s" % str(targets))
	var b_near_death: int = deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", 1 << 30)
	var order_ok := true
	for e in list:
		var expect := "B_near" if int(e["f"]) <= b_near_death else "B_far"
		if e["target"] != expect:
			order_ok = false
	_inv("(b) every shot takes B_near while it lives, then B_far", order_ok and list.size() >= 2,
		"targets %s" % str(targets))
	_timing("(b) first fired frame after the spawn", int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1,
		B_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(b) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), B_SHOT_GAPS)
	await _settle()


## (c) The target leaves the cone because the archer moves away (D held), and comes back (A held).
func _scen_c() -> void:
	_begin("c")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "C1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	var exit_f := -1
	var cd_zero_f := -1
	var reentry_f := -1
	var moved_ok := 0
	var moved_bad := 0
	var moved_detail := ""
	while _live(id) != null and f < 400:
		var x0 := game.archer.position.x
		var cd_before := game.archer.fire_cooldown
		var holding := f < C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS   # a move key is held for tick f + 1
		await _step()
		if holding and cd_before > 1.5 * TICK:
			var dx := absf(game.archer.position.x - x0)
			if absf(dx - Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK) < 1e-6:
				moved_ok += 1
			else:
				moved_bad += 1
				moved_detail += "[f=%d dx=%.4f] " % [f, dx]
		var c := _live(id)
		if c != null:
			var inc := _in_cone(c)
			if exit_f < 0 and not inc:
				exit_f = f
			elif exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and inc:
				reentry_f = f
		if exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and cd_zero_f < 0 and game.archer.fire_cooldown == 0.0:
			cd_zero_f = f
		if f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_D, false)
			_key(KEY_A, true)
		elif f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_A, false)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	var list := _shots_in("c")
	var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
	var out_shots := 0
	var reentry_shot := -1
	for e in list:
		if exit_f >= 0 and int(e["f"]) >= exit_f and (reentry_f < 0 or int(e["f"]) < reentry_f):
			out_shots += 1
		if reentry_f >= 0 and reentry_shot < 0 and int(e["f"]) >= reentry_f:
			reentry_shot = int(e["f"])
	print("MEASURED c: shots at f %s, exit f %d, cooldown 0 at f %d, re-entry f %d, re-entry shot f %d, died f %s" % [
		str(fs), exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, reentry_shot, str(deaths.get("C1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(c) no shot while the target is outside the cone, though the cooldown is 0",
		exit_f > 0 and reentry_f > exit_f and cd_zero_f >= exit_f and out_shots == 0,
		"exit %d cd0 %d reentry %d shots between %d" % [exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, out_shots])
	_inv("the archer moves %.0f px per tick while the cooldown runs (%d ticks checked)" % [
		Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK, moved_ok], moved_ok > 0 and moved_bad == 0, moved_detail)
	_timing("(c) first fired frame after the spawn", int(fs[0]) if not fs.is_empty() else -1, C_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target leaves the cone", exit_f, C_EXIT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the cooldown reaches 0 while it is outside", cd_zero_f, C_CD_ZERO_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target is back in the cone", reentry_f, C_REENTRY_F)
	_timing("(c) fired frame - re-entry frame", reentry_shot - reentry_f, C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY)
	await _settle()


## (d) P pressed mid-cooldown, and again D_PAUSE_TICKS frames later.
func _scen_d() -> void:
	_begin("d")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 250), "D1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var paused_ok := false
	var resumed_ok := false
	var frozen_y := true
	var y_at_pause := 0.0
	var cd_at_pause := -1.0
	var cd_after_pause := -1.0
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
		await _step()
		var c := _live(id)
		if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F:
			cd_at_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
			y_at_pause = c.position.y if c else 0.0
			_tap(KEY_P)
			paused_ok = paused
		elif f > D_PAUSE_AT_F and f <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
			if c and not is_equal_approx(c.position.y, y_at_pause):
				frozen_y = false
			if f == D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
				cd_after_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
				_tap(KEY_P)
				resumed_ok = not paused
	var list := _shots_in("d")
	var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
	var s1 := int(fs[0]) if fs.size() > 0 else -1
	var s2 := int(fs[1]) if fs.size() > 1 else -1
	var paused_shots := 0
	for e in list:
		if int(e["f"]) > D_PAUSE_AT_F and int(e["f"]) <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:
			paused_shots += 1
	var cadence: int = A_SHOT_GAPS[0] if A_SHOT_GAPS.size() > 0 else FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS
	print("MEASURED d: shots at f %s, gaps %s, cd at pause %.6f, cd after %d paused ticks %.6f, died f %s" % [
		str(fs), str(_gaps(list)), cd_at_pause, D_PAUSE_TICKS, cd_after_pause,
		str(deaths.get("D1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(d) P pauses mid-cooldown and P again resumes", paused_ok and resumed_ok and cd_at_pause > 0.0,
		"paused %s resumed %s cd %.4f" % [paused_ok, resumed_ok, cd_at_pause])
	_inv("(d) while paused: no shot, the cooldown and the scarecrow do not change",
		paused_shots == 0 and cd_after_pause == cd_at_pause and frozen_y,
		"shots %d cd %.6f->%.6f frozen_y %s" % [paused_shots, cd_at_pause, cd_after_pause, frozen_y])
	_timing("(d) first fired frame", s1, D_SHOT1_F)
	_timing("(d) second fired frame (after the pause)", s2, D_SHOT2_F)
	_timing("(d) shift of the second shot by the %d-frame pause" % D_PAUSE_TICKS, s2 - s1 - cadence, D_PAUSE_SHIFT)
	var later := _gaps(list).slice(1)
	var later_ok := true
	for g in later:
		later_ok = later_ok and int(g) == cadence
	_inv("(d) shots after the pause keep the unpaused cadence (%d)" % cadence, later_ok, "gaps %s" % str(_gaps(list)))
	await _settle()


## (e) With the archer at the right edge, a scarecrow walks down to the wall outside the cone and stops.
func _scen_e() -> void:
	_begin("e-setup")
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	while game.archer.position.x < Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN and f < 300:
		await _step()
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	await _step()
	_begin("e")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(160, 400), "E1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var ever_in_cone := _in_cone(s)
	var wall_f := -1
	var hold := 0
	var gate_at_wall := 0.0
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600 and hold < E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS:
		await _step()
		var c := _live(id)
		if c == null:
			break
		ever_in_cone = ever_in_cone or _in_cone(c)
		if wall_f < 0 and c.at_wall:
			wall_f = f
			gate_at_wall = game.gate_hp
		elif wall_f >= 0:
			hold += 1
	var c2 := _live(id)
	var still := c2 != null and c2.at_wall and is_equal_approx(c2.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
	print("MEASURED e: archer x %.2f, at_wall at f %d, y %.2f after %d more frames, gate %.4f -> %.4f" % [
		game.archer.position.x, wall_f, c2.position.y if c2 else -1.0, hold, gate_at_wall, game.gate_hp])
	_inv("(e) setup: the scarecrow never enters the cone, no shot", not ever_in_cone and _shots_in("e").is_empty())
	_inv("(e) the scarecrow at the wall stays at y %.0f for %d frames and hits the gate" % [
		Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y, E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS], still and hold == E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS and game.gate_hp < gate_at_wall)
	_timing("(e) frame the scarecrow reaches the wall (spawn at y 400 = f 0)", wall_f, E_WALL_F)


## (f) A loss with the archer still firing, then R, then Enter, then the first shot of the new run.
func _scen_f() -> void:
	_begin("f")
	var t0 := transitions.size()
	var ax := game.archer.position.x
	var i := 1
	for dx in [-60.0, -48.0, -36.0, -24.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(ax + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "F%d" % i)
		i += 1
	i = 1
	for x in [300.0, 400.0, 500.0, 600.0, 700.0, 800.0]:
		_spawn(Vector2(x, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y), "W%d" % i)
		i += 1
	var r_in_play_ok := true
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and f < 900:
		await _step()
		if f == 10:
			var hp := game.gate_hp
			_tap(KEY_R)
			r_in_play_ok = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t0
			print("INFO (f) R during play at f 10: state %s, gate %.4f (was %.4f)" % [
				Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, hp])
	var loss_f := f
	var lost := game.state == Game.State.LOST
	var list := _shots_in("f")
	var last_shot_f := int(list.back()["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
	var firing := not list.is_empty() and loss_f - last_shot_f < FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1
	var cd_at_loss := game.archer.fire_cooldown
	var x_at_loss := game.archer.position.x
	var arrows_at_loss := _live_arrows()
	_tap(KEY_D)   # a move key while the game is over (pressed and released at once)
	_key(KEY_A, true)
	for k in F_FROZEN_TICKS:
		await _step()
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	var frozen := game.archer.fire_cooldown == cd_at_loss and game.archer.position.x == x_at_loss \
			and _live_arrows() == arrows_at_loss and game.state == Game.State.LOST
	var shots_after_loss := 0
	for e in _shots_in("f"):
		if int(e["f"]) > loss_f:
			shots_after_loss += 1
	print("MEASURED f: shots at f %s, LOST at f %d, last shot f %d, cd at loss %.6f, %d arrows in flight" % [
		str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), loss_f, last_shot_f, cd_at_loss, arrows_at_loss])

	_tap(KEY_R)
	run_id += 1
	act = 0
	var restarted := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING
	print("INFO (f) R after the loss: state %s, gate %.4f, archer x %.2f, cd %.6f" % [
		Game.State.keys()[game.state], game.gate_hp, game.archer.position.x, game.archer.fire_cooldown])
	for k in 5:
		await _step()
	var t_before_enter := transitions.size()
	_tap(KEY_ENTER)
	var enter_noop := game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and transitions.size() == t_before_enter
	for k in 5:
		await _step()
	var spawn_f := f
	_spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "G1")
	var shot_f := -1
	var n0 := shots.size()
	while f < spawn_f + 120 and shot_f < 0:
		await _step()
		if shots.size() > n0:
			shot_f = int(shots[n0]["f"])
	print("MEASURED f: new run: G1 spawned at f %d, first fired at f %d" % [spawn_f, shot_f])

	var states := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> int: return t["state"])
	var tr_txt := transitions.slice(t0).map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String:
		return "%s@f%d key=%d age=%d" % [Game.State.keys()[t["state"]], t["f"], t["key"], t["key_age"]])
	print("INFO (f) transitions: %s" % str(tr_txt))
	var via_key := states.size() == 2 and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key"]) == KEY_R \
			and int(transitions[t0 + 1]["key_age"]) == 0 and int(transitions[t0]["key_age"]) > 0
	_inv("(f) setup: the run is lost with the archer still firing (a shot within %d frames before)" % [
		FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS + 1], lost and firing, "lost %s last shot f %d loss f %d" % [lost, last_shot_f, loss_f])
	_inv("(f) R during play does nothing", r_in_play_ok)
	_inv("(f) after the loss: no shot, cooldown, archer x and arrows frozen, keys ignored, state stays LOST",
		frozen and shots_after_loss == 0, "frozen %s shots after %d" % [frozen, shots_after_loss])
	_inv("(f) run states go PLAYING -> LOST -> PLAYING, the last only on the R press", restarted and via_key
		and states == [Game.State.LOST, Game.State.PLAYING], str(tr_txt))
	_inv("(f) Enter right after the restart (state PLAYING) does nothing", enter_noop)
	_timing("(f) frame the run is LOST", loss_f, F_LOSS_F)
	_timing("(f) new run: fired frame - spawn frame", shot_f - spawn_f, F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY)


# ---- invariants over every shot of the whole test ------------------------------------------------

func _global_invariants() -> void:
	var no_target := PackedStringArray()
	var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
	var bad_parent := 0
	var during_pause := 0
	for e in shots:
		if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:
			no_target.append("%s f%d" % [e["scen"], e["f"]])
		if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
			not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])
		if not e["parent_ok"]:
			bad_parent += 1
		if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:
			during_pause += 1
	var close := PackedStringArray()
	var min_gap := 1 << 30
	for k in range(1, shots.size()):
		if shots[k]["run"] != shots[k - 1]["run"]:
			continue
		var g := int(shots[k]["act"]) - int(shots[k - 1]["act"])
		min_gap = mini(min_gap, g)
		if g * TICK < Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL - 1e-9:
			close.append("%s f%d gap %d" % [shots[k]["scen"], shots[k]["f"], g])
	print("INFO %d shots in total; smallest gap in archer-active frames within a run: %d" % [shots.size(), min_gap])
	_inv("no shot without a target in the cone (%d shots)" % shots.size(), no_target.is_empty(), str(no_target))
	_inv("never two shots closer than FIRE_INTERVAL in archer-active frames (min %d)" % min_gap, close.is_empty(),
		str(close))
	_inv("exactly one arrow under World/Arrows per fired, in the same frame",
		inv_arrow_mismatch == 0 and bad_parent == 0, inv_arrow_detail)
	_inv("no shot and no cooldown change on a frame the archer is paused or the game has ended",
		inv_inactive_shots == 0 and inv_inactive_cd_changes == 0 and during_pause == 0, inv_inactive_detail)
	_inv("every shot takes the nearest scarecrow in the cone", not_nearest.is_empty(), str(not_nearest))
	_inv("a scarecrow at the wall never moves", inv_wall_moves == 0, inv_wall_detail)

extends SceneTree
## Step 2 pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §5, §10): what the archer does NOW, before any clip exists.
## Drives the real main scene only through keyboard events (Input.parse_input_event); never calls an
## archer or scarecrow method that changes state, never assigns to their variables. It only spawns
## scarecrows with Game.spawn_scarecrow() and reads state.
##   ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
##
## Frame model. --fixed-fps 60 and 60 physics ticks/s: one main-loop iteration = one physics tick.
## The script resumes on SceneTree.physics_frame, which is emitted BEFORE the nodes' physics step.
## So at each resume the world shows the result of the previous tick, and whatever the script does
## there (keys, spawns) takes effect in the next tick. A scenario's frame f counts game ticks
## completed since the scenario's setup (f = 0 is the setup itself). An event emitted during a
## tick (fired, died) is stamped with that tick's f and shows up in the log line of the same f.
## Every log line begins with Engine.get_process_frames() at the moment it is printed.
##
## TIMING = numbers the brief changes on purpose (§5); re-pinned in Step 6.
## INVARIANT = must survive the change.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
const FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS := 36            # Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL (0.6 s) at 60 ticks/s

# ---- scenario design (chosen, not measured) ----------------------------------------------------
const C_HOLD_D_TICKS := 40                 # (c) D held for ticks 1..40, then A for ticks 41..80
const C_HOLD_A_TICKS := 40
const D_PAUSE_AT_F := 15                   # (d) P pressed after tick 15 ...
const D_PAUSE_TICKS := 30                  # ... and again 30 ticks later
const E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS := 30              # (e) ticks watched after the scarecrow reaches the wall
const F_FROZEN_TICKS := 30                 # (f) ticks watched after the loss before R

# ---- TIMING: measured on baseline 2026-11-21 ----------------------------------------------------
const A_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (a) spawn (in the cone, cooldown 0) at f 0 -> first fired
const A_SHOT_GAPS := [-999]                # (a) ticks between consecutive shots
const A_DEATH_F := -999                    # (a) tick the scarecrow dies
const B_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (b) spawn at f 0 -> first fired
const B_SHOT_GAPS := [-999]
const C_FIRST_SHOT_F := -999               # (c) spawn at f 0 -> first fired
const C_EXIT_F := -999                     # (c) first frame the target is outside the cone
const C_CD_ZERO_F := -999                  # (c) first frame the cooldown is 0 while it is outside
const C_REENTRY_F := -999                  # (c) first frame it is back inside the cone
const C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY := -999         # (c) fired frame - re-entry frame
const D_SHOT1_F := -999                    # (d) first fired
const D_SHOT2_F := -999                    # (d) second fired, after the pause
const D_PAUSE_SHIFT := -999                # (d) (shot2 - shot1) - unpaused cadence
const E_WALL_F := -999                     # (e) spawn at y 400 at f 0 -> first frame at_wall
const F_LOSS_F := -999                     # (f) frame the run is LOST
const F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY := -999         # (f) new run: spawn at f_s -> fired frame - f_s

var game: Game
var timing: Array[String] = []
var invariant: Array[String] = []
var passed := 0
var failed := 0

var scen := ""
var f := 0                 # ticks completed since the scenario's setup
var gt := 0                # ticks completed since the test started
var run_id := 0            # incremented by each restart
var act := 0               # ticks the archer processed (not paused, World enabled) in this run
var next_active := true    # will the archer process the coming tick?
var prev_cd := 0.0
var pending: Array[Dictionary] = []   # fired events since the last log line
var shots: Array[Dictionary] = []     # every fired event
var arrows_added := 0                 # arrows that entered World/Arrows since the last log line
var tracked: Array[int] = []          # scarecrow instance ids
var labels := {}                      # id -> label
var deaths := {}                      # label -> {scen, f}
var wall_prev := {}                   # id -> [at_wall, y] at the previous log line
var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
var last_key := -1
var last_key_gt := -1

# invariant counters, whole run
var inv_inactive_shots := 0
var inv_inactive_cd_changes := 0
var inv_inactive_detail := ""
var inv_arrow_mismatch := 0
var inv_arrow_detail := ""
var inv_wall_moves := 0
var inv_wall_detail := ""


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
	game.arrows.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: arrows_added += 1)
	game.state_changed.connect(_on_state_changed)
	await process_frame
	scen = "boot"
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

	await _scen_a()
	await _scen_b()
	await _scen_c()
	await _scen_d()
	await _scen_e()
	await _scen_f()
	_global_invariants()

	print("== TIMING (changed on purpose by brief §5; re-pinned in Step 6) ==")
	for line in timing:
		print(line)
	print("== INVARIANT (must survive the change) ==")
	for line in invariant:
		print(line)
	print("RESULT test_pins_a7: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# ---- checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _record(group: Array[String], name: String, ok: bool, detail: String) -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		group.append("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		group.append("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _timing(name: String, measured: Variant, pinned: Variant) -> void:
	_record(timing, "%s = %s" % [name, str(pinned)], measured == pinned, "measured %s" % str(measured))


func _inv(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	_record(invariant, name, ok, detail)


# ---- input --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	if pressed:
		last_key = code
		last_key_gt = gt
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _tap(code: Key) -> void:
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)


# ---- reading the world --------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _in_cone(s: Scarecrow) -> bool:
	var to := s.global_position - game.archer.global_position
	return absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) <= deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)


func _live(id: int) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
	if s == null or not s.is_inside_tree() or s.is_queued_for_deletion() or s.is_dead():
		return null
	return s


func _nearest_in_cone() -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_d := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead() or not _in_cone(s):
			continue
		var d := (s.global_position - game.archer.global_position).length()
		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = s
	return best


func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_a := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
		if a < best_a:
			best_a = a
			best = s
	return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null


func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
	return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))


func _live_arrows() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.arrows.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	tracked.append(id)
	labels[id] = label
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
	return s


func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for s in shots:
		if s["scen"] == sc:
			out.append(s)
	return out


func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for i in range(1, list.size()):
		out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))

# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
	var near := _nearest_in_cone()
	var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
		"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
		"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
		"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
	pending.append(ev)
	shots.append(ev)


func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
	transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f, "gt": gt, "state": s, "key": last_key,
		"key_age": gt - last_key_gt})


# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _step() -> void:
	next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await physics_frame
	f += 1
	gt += 1
	if next_active:
		act += 1
	var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown

	if not next_active:
		if not pending.is_empty():
			inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
		if cd != prev_cd:
			inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
	if arrows_added != pending.size():
		inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
		inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]

	var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for e in pending:
		fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
	var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for id in tracked:
		var s := _live(id)
		if s == null:
			wall_prev.erase(id)
			continue
		sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
			s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
		if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
		if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
		wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]

	print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
		Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
		game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
	pending.clear()
	arrows_added = 0
	prev_cd = cd


func _begin(name: String) -> void:
	scen = name
	f = 0
	print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)


## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0:
		var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
		for id in tracked:
			if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
				busy = true
		if not busy:
			break
		await _step()
		cap -= 1
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

# ---- invariants over every shot of the whole test ------------------------------------------------

func _global_invariants() -> void:
	var no_target := PackedStringArray()
	var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
	var bad_parent := 0
	var during_pause := 0
	for e in shots:
		if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:
			no_target.append("%s f%d" % [e["scen"], e["f"]])
		if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
			not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])
		if not e["parent_ok"]:
			bad_parent += 1
		if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:
			during_pause += 1
	var close := PackedStringArray()
	var min_gap := 1 << 30
	for k in range(1, shots.size()):
		if shots[k]["run"] != shots[k - 1]["run"]:
			continue
		var g := int(shots[k]["act"]) - int(shots[k - 1]["act"])
		min_gap = mini(min_gap, g)
		if g * TICK < Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL - 1e-9:
			close.append("%s f%d gap %d" % [shots[k]["scen"], shots[k]["f"], g])
	print("INFO %d shots in total; smallest gap in archer-active frames within a run: %d" % [shots.size(), min_gap])
	_inv("no shot without a target in the cone (%d shots)" % shots.size(), no_target.is_empty(), str(no_target))
	_inv("never two shots closer than FIRE_INTERVAL in archer-active frames (min %d)" % min_gap, close.is_empty(),
		str(close))
	_inv("exactly one arrow under World/Arrows per fired, in the same frame",
		inv_arrow_mismatch == 0 and bad_parent == 0, inv_arrow_detail)
	_inv("no shot and no cooldown change on a frame the archer is paused or the game has ended",
		inv_inactive_shots == 0 and inv_inactive_cd_changes == 0 and during_pause == 0, inv_inactive_detail)
	_inv("every shot takes the nearest scarecrow in the cone", not_nearest.is_empty(), str(not_nearest))
	_inv("a scarecrow at the wall never moves", inv_wall_moves == 0, inv_wall_detail)
